VibeCoded Tools Launcher — Third-Party License Notice
======================================================

The launcher binary distributed in this directory (vct-launcher / vct-launcher.exe)
is licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later, the same license as vibecoded-orchestrator
itself. See the repo root LICENSE file for the AGPL-3.0 full text.

This binary statically links and dynamically loads several third-party libraries.
Their licenses are listed below. None of these libraries' terms restrict our
ability to ship the binary alongside the AGPL source under the same terms.

For an exhaustive, machine-generated license inventory of every transitive Rust
crate compiled into the binary, contributors should run `cargo about generate`
in launcher/src-tauri/ at release time. This file is the human-curated summary
covering the major components.

----------------------------------------------------------------------

URL: https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri

----------------------------------------------------------------------
2. webkit2gtk (Linux runtime — DYNAMICALLY LINKED)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
License: LGPL-2.1-only (libraries) and BSD-2-Clause (some components)
Copyright: WebKit contributors
URL: https://webkit.org/

The launcher uses webkit2gtk DYNAMICALLY (loaded at runtime from the host's
system libraries — typically /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libwebkit2gtk-4.1.so.0).
Per LGPL-2.1 § 6, this constitutes "use" rather than "derivative work" of the
LGPL'd library, and our binary distribution does not need to be LGPL-licensed.

Users may replace the webkit2gtk library on their system with a different
version; the launcher binary will load whatever webkit2gtk-4.1 the OS provides.
Source code for webkit2gtk is available at https://webkit.org/getting-the-code/.

The full LGPL-2.1 text is available at:
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/lgpl-2.1.txt

----------------------------------------------------------------------
3. WebView2 (Windows runtime — DYNAMICALLY LINKED)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
License: Microsoft proprietary (distributable per WebView2 Runtime Distribution
         Agreement)
Copyright: Microsoft Corporation
URL: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/

The launcher .exe loads WebView2 Runtime, which Microsoft pre-installs on
Windows 10 1903+ and Windows 11. We do NOT redistribute WebView2 — users
obtain it from Microsoft. If the runtime is missing, the launcher prints a
download link to https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/.

Microsoft's distribution terms allow free use of WebView2 Runtime by any
application without per-distribution licensing.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
4. WKWebView (macOS runtime — system framework)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
License: Part of Apple's macOS — no separate redistribution required.
Copyright: Apple Inc.

The launcher .app bundle uses WKWebView from the host macOS WebKit framework.
No additional licensing applies; users have already accepted Apple's macOS EULA.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
5. Rust standard library + transitive crates
----------------------------------------------------------------------
License: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (Rust stdlib); various MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD-2-Clause/
         BSD-3-Clause for transitive crates.

The launcher's Cargo.toml depends on ~150 crates transitively. Notable direct
dependencies (see launcher/src-tauri/Cargo.toml for the full list):

  serde, serde_json, tokio, reqwest, axum  - MIT OR Apache-2.0
  tauri-plugin-opener, tauri-plugin-dialog - MIT OR Apache-2.0
  rusqlite                                 - MIT
  directories                              - MIT OR Apache-2.0

For a complete machine-readable list, run from launcher/src-tauri/:
    cargo install cargo-about
    cargo about generate -c about.toml -o ../dist/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.html

----------------------------------------------------------------------
6. Frontend (SvelteKit + bundled webview assets)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
License: MIT (SvelteKit and most npm dependencies); see launcher/package.json.

The launcher's HTML/CSS/JS bundle is embedded in the Rust binary via Tauri's
asset packaging. License headers for those bundled assets are in the project's
package-lock.json + the SvelteKit project source.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
Generating an exhaustive inventory
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Maintainers cutting a release should generate the full transitive license
list and ship it alongside this summary file. From the repo root:

    cd launcher/src-tauri
    cargo install cargo-about
    cargo about generate -c about.toml -o ../dist/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.html

(Create about.toml with `cargo about init` if not present; commit both.)
